blurb: Welcome to South Baptiste Cabins, RV, Camping & Storage, located on the shores of Baptiste Lake in the Athabasca River Basin in central Alberta, northwest of Edmonton. Our cabins and campsites are perfect for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy the great outdoors. Our RV sites and storage options offer convenient options for those traveling through the area.
